summary: A fast 4x4 with a roof machine gun and room for five soldiers. It sees far, shreds infantry and light vehicles, and carries its passengers into the fight with their weapons ready.

sections.title: Roof machine gun
sections.how: Select the Mengshi and left-click an enemy, or let it fire at anything in range.
sections.body: The roof-mounted machine gun fires quick bursts. It tears through infantry, scouts and other light vehicles, and can answer low drones. Against a main battle tank it struggles badly.

sections.title: Carry infantry
sections.how: Select one or more riflemen or HJ-12 teams, then left-click your own Mengshi.
sections.body: Up to five soldiers ride hidden inside and cannot be selected until they get out. If the Mengshi is destroyed, everyone aboard dies with it.

sections.title: Fire from inside
sections.how: Load riflemen into the Mengshi and drive close to the enemy; the passengers fire on their own.
sections.body: The Mengshi has firing ports, so its passengers shoot from inside with their own weapons instead of standing in the open. They stay hidden and untargetable while they ride.

sections.title: Unload
sections.how: Select the loaded Mengshi and press Unload (n).
sections.body: The riders step out one after another beside the vehicle. Drive close to the objective first, then unload.

sections.title: Repair at the vehicle factory
sections.how: Select the damaged Mengshi and press Repair at factory, or left-click your vehicle factory.
sections.body: The Mengshi drives to the factory and is repaired for half its price, paid as the health comes back.

tips: Use its sight to find the enemy first: the Mengshi sees further than it shoots.
Load a squad before driving into the open so the passengers keep firing from inside.
Do not lead with it: let tanks take the hits while the Mengshi hunts infantry and light vehicles.
Composite armour from the vehicle factory adds health to the Mengshi.
